inputs.lyrics:
I was angry with my friend:
I told my wrath, my wrath did end.
I was angry with my foe:
I told it not, my wrath did grow.

And I watered it in fears,
Night and morning with my tears;
And I sunned it with smiles,
And with soft deceitful wiles.

And it grew both day and night,
Till it bore an apple bright.
And my foe beheld it shine.
And he knew that it was mine,

And into my garden stole
When the night had veiled the pole;
In the morning glad I see
My foe outstretched beneath the tree.

inputs.lyrics:
Garis yang Memudar"

Di antara bayang dan terang yang samar,
Ada tempat di mana semua tercampur dan kabur.
Tak ada hitam putih, tak ada benar salah,
Aku melangkah di jalan yang penuh tanda tanya.

Apakah aku pahlawan atau hanya ilusi?
Saat semua tindakan bercampur ambiguitas pasti.
Garis di antara baik dan jahat semakin pudar,
Kehilangan arah di dunia yang kelam dan liar.

Garis yang memudar, siapa yang benar?
Dalam dunia ini, niat suci bisa menyamar.
Mimpi dan dosa bertemu dalam satu warna,
Tak ada kepastian di balik semua bara.

Setiap pilihan adalah pedang bermata dua,
Antara menyelamatkan atau malah menghancurkan asa.
Aku berjuang, tapi tak tahu apa yang kubela,
Dalam kabut moral ini, aku mencari makna.

Apakah cahaya bisa lahir dari kegelapan?
Saat niat baik terjerat dalam bayangan.
Mungkin aku terikat dalam takdir yang keliru,
Tapi garis ini, tak pernah jelas atau lurus.

(Chorus)
Garis yang memudar, siapa yang benar?
Dalam dunia ini, niat suci bisa menyamar.
Mimpi dan dosa bertemu dalam satu warna,
Tak ada kepastian di balik semua bara.

Di ujung batas, aku berdiri sendiri,
Mempertanyakan tujuan di balik mimpi.
Mungkin baik dan jahat hanyalah dua sisi,
Dari koin yang berputar tanpa henti.

Garis yang memudar, tak ada hitam atau putih,
Hanya abu-abu dalam setiap langkah yang ku pijak.
Apakah aku pahlawan, atau malah penghancur jiwa?
Di dunia ini, tak ada jawaban yang sempurna.

inputs.style: Slow Afrobeat rhythm with warm bass, soft percussion, and gentle guitar riffs. R&b vocals are smooth and soulful,
inputs.lyrics:
Intro (Soft Guitar and Light Percussion):
(Repeated words: “Feel you, feel you, feel you… still feel you, feel you, feel you…”)
(Background harmonies: “Still feel you…”)

(“Feel you… yeah, I still feel you…”)
(Soft scatting: “Da-da, mmm, feel you…”)

(The guitar and vocals create a warm, introspective groove, building the feeling of a memory that won’t fade.)

Verse 1
I tried to move on, keep it all in the past,
But I feel your touch in every breath I take.
Can’t shake the echoes of things that we had,
Your scent, your smile, all the memories I can’t shake.

(Background: “Memories I can’t shake…”)

Pre-Chorus
I’m out here pretending, actin’ brand new,
But you left a shadow I can’t see through.
Got me lost in this space where you used to be,
Still feel you right here, haunting me.

(“Still feel you… haunting me…”)

Chorus
I still feel you, baby, in every beat,
Like a rhythm I can’t forget, can’t delete.
You left your mark, yeah, you cut so deep,
Still feel you, babe, even in my sleep.

(Ad-libs: “Oh, so deep…” “Can’t shake you…”)

Verse 2
We had a love, yeah, it burned so strong,
Now it’s just ashes, but they linger on.
Every song I play, every word I hear,
Brings me back, wishin’ you were still here.

(Background: “Wishin’ you were here…”)

Pre-Chorus
Friends say, “move on, let it be,”
But you’re in my skin, you’re a part of me.
Feels like a ghost that I can’t release,
Still feel you here, givin’ me no peace.

(“Givin’ me no peace…”)

Chorus
I still feel you, baby, in every beat,
Like a rhythm I can’t forget, can’t delete.
You left your mark, yeah, you cut so deep,
Still feel you, babe, even in my sleep.

(Ad-libs: “Yeah, it’s so deep…” “Can’t let go…”)

Bridge (Soft Scatting and Guitar)
(Scatting: “Da-da-da, yeah, mmm…”)
(“Wish you’d let me be…”)
The guitar riff gently plays under the scat lines, adding a reflective and melancholic feel.

Chorus (Extended Harmonies and Deep Ad-libs)
I still feel you, baby, in every beat,
Like a rhythm I can’t forget, can’t delete.
You left your mark, yeah, you cut so deep,
Still feel you, babe, even in my sleep.

(Ad-libs: “Won’t let me go…” “So deep…”)

Outro (Guitar and Soft Scatting Fading Out)
(“Still feel you, yeah… can’t let go…”)
(Scatting: “Da-da-da…”)
The guitar and scatting fade out, leaving a lingering sense of unresolved emotion.
